title: Unknown-cause single command analogue
purpose: Exercise documented unknown-cause handling while retaining a complete Single Command structure with altered addressing and qualifier fields.
expected_behavior: The peer recognizes the complete APCI and ASDU structure, then handles documented cause 45 as Unknown Cause of Transmission through its normal validation or error-response path without process termination.
constraints_preserved: Cause 45 is the documented Unknown Cause of Transmission value.
Type 45 is the documented Single Command identifier.
The ASDU preserves type, VSQ, two-octet cause, common address, three-octet IOA, and command qualifier order.
The I-format length 0x0e is consistent with four control octets plus ten ASDU octets.
The frame is a structural analogue only and does not reproduce issue 13 exact bytes, length 0xe0, or zero-filled payload.
issue_safety_notes: This is an issue-focused parser analogue using a documented exceptional cause with a compact, fully length-consistent frame. It avoids the exact historical crash input and does not claim to reproduce the reported root cause.
